parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale properly addresses all three error targets: it removes the misapplication of rubric level 5 by clarifying that identifying problem locations is not equivalent to concrete implementation guidance, it explains why the action is vague (no specifics on what details to add or which citations), and it corrects the score mapping error by describing the appropriate rubric level without explicitly stating a numeric score or gold label.
